notes:
Top-line: product team (Search & Assistant) evaluating Redwood as primary inference platform. Started with hosted API demo; moving toward Dedicated if unit economics align.

Key asks: tight latency (p50 token <60ms for chat), embeddings throughput ~400 qps, budget-conscious — wants clear unit economics. Interested in Optimize features: batching suggestions, KV/prefix caching to reduce tokens, and recommended quantization profiles for their model (MPT-like, 7B family).

From call: "We like the API and the streaming ergonomics, but need concrete cost/latency numbers for our 6-month growth plan." — Head of Product.

Cost workshop notes: focus on realistic traffic shape (spiky mornings), expected cache hit assuming 15% repeated prefixes; need simulation of batching gains with their average prompt size (350 tokens). Diego ran initial sims; projected 30-40% token-cost reduction with conservative caching + 4-bit quantization, but product team wants quality A/B evals.

Security: must support SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, KMS integration and audit logs. Data residency: prefer NA region but need confirmation of dedicated routing for EU customers.

Next steps: run cost-optimization workshop (week of 3/15), ingest 48h of traffic for replay POC, deliver committed-capacity pricing for Dedicated and hosted ramp plan. Blockers: procurement timeline (budget cycle ends 3/31), SSO rollout window, finalizing acceptable quality delta for quantization.
